title: Static High-Disc Truncate-Rear Opposed-Fin Sunfish
description: One newly authored whole static stylised ocean-sunfish-like exterior. A thick but strongly side-compressed high rounded head-body has a small blunt front mouth and a broad abrupt rear, with no narrow tail peduncle or separate forked tail. A full shallow scalloped rear fin edge spans that truncated rear. One tall swept upper fin and one long opposed lower fin project from the back half of the body; the lower fin ends in a small deliberate finite flat display datum. Two small short side fins and two lateral eyes complete the animal. All stations, profiles and fin paths newly authored, not the old horizontal asymmetric flatfish rotated or the rounded puffer scaled flat. Unlike those assets it has a high side disc, broad truncate rear and dominant opposed vertical fins, not a continuous marginal fringe or ball belly leading to a short caudal stock. One model zero scenes. Static coarse game-art pose only, not an actual ground-standing fish or exact species, anatomy, locomotion, marine biology, aquarium care or safety representation. Rig animation interaction not made.
